disposition_reason: EFSA FAF follow-up opinion on the emulsifier PGPR (E 476). Toxic-element data concern the additive itself (13 commercial E 476 samples all below LOQ; proposed lowest achievable Pb 0.5, Hg 0.1, Cd 0.2 mg/kg in the additive vs current spec Pb 2, Hg 1, Cd 1, As 3 mg/kg). Cocoa and chocolate products (FC 05.1) appear as the main food category contributing to PGPR exposure and as authorised-use categories; one filled-chocolate PGPR result was excluded as suspect sampling. No metal concentrations in cocoa or chocolate.
disposition_locator: Section 3.1 Table 1 (EU specifications for E 476); Section 3.2.1 and Table 2 (toxic elements in E 476); Section 3.3.1 authorised uses table rows FC 05.1/05.2/05.4; Section 3.3.2 (filled chocolate sample excluded); Section 3.3.3 'Main food categories contributing' (FC 05.1); Section 3.4.1 Table 9

study.material_scope: food additive E 476; cocoa/chocolate only as use and exposure-contributing category

unresolved: Metal limits apply to the additive E 476, not to cocoa or chocolate; any carry-over contribution to chocolate metal content is not quantified in the opinion.
